purpose: Retain all 23 full weekly calendar origins before Phase 3; strict 16-week evaluation becomes a sensitivity reference
source_protocol: phase1-v1; training split, model selection, model families, fitting observations and preprocessing unchanged
terminal_remainder: 163 hours reported separately; not scored as a full week
score_mask: original PM2.5 and every broad-set PP covariate observed at that hour; identical for all families, regimes and sensitivities
historical_gap_policy: Inference context only: replace a missing historical value with the value 168 hours earlier, recursively using past values; fallback to latest prior available value only where no seasonal antecedent exists. Preserve every observed value. Never fill fitting targets or scoring targets.
future_gap_policy: Unavailable-input hours are excluded from scoring. Computational placeholders are the training mean in raw input units; perturb to mean plus ten training standard deviations and require scored forecasts unchanged before accepting each affected origin. Mask unavailable-input predictions in the stored stream.
correction: Recompute on all 23 origins. Apply bias before outcomes are available; update from the mean base residual of observed scored hours in that week. Save scored-hour counts. Alpha remains predefined; no test selection.
additional_sarimax_solver: Established Phase 2 recovery policy: initialize from earlier converged initial selected fit, adjust slope scales, optimize same likelihood using complex-step L-BFGS-B, maxiter 200/maxls 100 and default tolerances. Accept finite converged fits only. Save source/cutoff and resources.
reuse: Reuse existing walk-forward fits/forecasts for the 16 complete-context/full-observation weeks with unchanged cutoffs. Reconstruct frozen SARIMAX from saved parameters and training filter. Refit frozen Prophet/NeuralProphet with identical seed/config/training, require reproduction on the strict 16 weeks before accepting the broader stream.
partial_week_metrics: Report pooled hourly MAE/RMSE separately from unweighted mean weekly metrics and SD; variable scored-hour counts prevent equating pooled MAE with mean weekly MAE.
limitations: Historical context filling is an assumption, including up to 120 missing context hours. Partially observed weeks do not establish full-week accuracy. Missingness can be informative. This protocol preserves the corrected calendar schedule, not the original irregular 168-row chunks.
